review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is argued that students who have the best academic performance should be rewarded by their school while others say that rewarding students who show improvements is more important. Personally, I believe that both of them should be equally encouraged.

Admittedly, it is obvious that students who show the best academic results should be rewarded. Initially, as these students have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards, therefore, propelling to towards overall academic gains. Moreover, this kind of competition can be seen in almost aspect of life where only the best individuals are rewarded, student are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, allowing them to achieve success in later life.

However, I believe that students who have improvements should also be encouraged. Firstly, if only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, this may cause others to think that their effort is futile because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals. In this way, they can prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened and gradually lose the incentive to study. Secondly, emphasizing improvements can encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves irrespective of how well they have been or are performing, creating the constant desire to outdo themselves. As a result, this can even benefit themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that rewarding both students having the best academic performance and students who have improvements is equally important.
review.overall: Em có bố cục rõ, bám đủ bốn ý của dàn ý và câu kết đúng hướng thưởng cả hai nhóm. Em cần sửa các lỗi nhỏ về dạng từ và tách câu dài để lập luận trôi chảy hơn.

paragraphs: Opinions are divided over whether schools should reward students with the best academic performance or whether it is more important to reward students who show progress. I believe that both groups should be equally rewarded.

Admittedly, students with the best academic results deserve rewards. Since they have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage them and other students to study harder, thereby propelling students towards overall academic gains. Moreover, competition exists in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. Students can become familiar with this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, which may prepare them for success in later life.

However, students who show progress should also be rewarded. If only a few high-achieving students receive rewards, others may feel that their effort is futile because they cannot surpass these individuals. As a result, they may feel disheartened and lose the incentive to study. Recognizing improvement can encourage all students to work diligently and to keep improving themselves, irrespective of their current performance. This desire to outdo themselves can create more lasting motivation than competing against others.
In conclusion, schools should reward both students with outstanding academic results and those who make progress.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
